method: Playwright-driven recon of the upstream US storefront; images fetched from the resolved upstream CDN URLs; inline logo SVG extracted from the rendered homepage
notes: static/css/site.css and templates are original mirror implementations matching the upstream layout and color tokens (#282727 ink, #001489 blue, DIN Next CYR). Product catalog, prices, colors, sizes, stores and policy copy are sourced from the upstream site; review prose and benchmark users are original fixtures.
